parameters.query: SELECT CASE $1 WHEN 'listItems' THEN steele_src.list_items($2, $5::integer) WHEN 'listVersions' THEN steele_src.list_versions($2, $3, $5::integer, $6::integer) ELSE steele_src.read_version($2, $4) END AS result

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { ok: false, httpStatus: 400, message: String($json.error?.message ?? $json.error) } }];

meta.description: listItems, listVersions (paged), readVersion and exportVersion, read from storage only (never refetched). Reads and exports are re-verified against their version ID.
